app.name: Tulaziva
app.tagline: Buy and sell second-hand, close to you

home.heroTitle: Find what you need, <1>close to you</1>
home.heroSubtitle: Thousands of second-hand ads posted by people in your area.
home.ctaTitle: Got something you no longer use?
home.ctaText: Post it in minutes and let others find it.

search.title: Ads
search.locationDenied: We couldn't get your location. Check the browser permissions.
search.emptyHint: Try other words or remove some filters.

ad.notFound: This ad doesn't exist or is no longer available.
ad.removeByAdminConfirm: The ad will no longer be public. Continue?

form.title: Title
form.locationHintCreate: If you don't set a location, the one from your registration is used.
form.locationHintEdit: If you don't change the location, the current one is kept.
form.imagesHint: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 5 MB · max {{max}}. The first one is the cover.

myAds.title: My ads
myAds.empty: You haven't posted any ads yet
myAds.emptyHint: Post your first one and start getting messages.
myAds.deleteConfirmText: It will be deleted along with its images. This cannot be undone.

auth.loginSubtitle: Log in to post ads and chat.
auth.registerSubtitle: It's free and takes less than a minute.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.shareLocation: Save my location to show you nearby ads
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please log in again.
auth.acceptTerms: I accept the <1>Terms of use</1> and the <2>Privacy notice</2>
auth.acceptTermsHint: You must accept them to create your account.

chat.title: Messages
chat.emptyHint: When you contact a seller, your chats will show up here.
chat.attachHint: JPG or PNG, up to 5 images of 10 MB
chat.fileInvalid: {{name}}: only JPG or PNG up to 10 MB are allowed
chat.deletedHint: This account no longer exists, so you cannot write here.

profile.title: My profile
profile.photoHint: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB
profile.emailSent: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm the change; until then your account keeps its current address.

admin.title: Administration
admin.name: Name
admin.privacyNote: For privacy only files are shown, never the text of the conversations.
admin.reportDismissHint: Closes the report and leaves the ad as it is
admin.reportResolveHint: Takes the ad down and closes every open report about it
admin.reportResolveConfirm: "{{title}}" will no longer be public and its open reports will be closed. Continue?
admin.reportResolved: Ad taken down and reports closed

footer.madeWith: Made with care for your community

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or was moved.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to see this.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

favorites.title: My favorites
favorites.empty: You haven't saved any ads yet
favorites.emptyHint: Tap the heart on an ad to save it and find it here. Expired or taken-down ads are not shown.

report.title: Report ad
report.intro: Tell us what is wrong. An administrator will review it. Your report is anonymous to the seller.

verify.banner: Confirm your email ({{email}}) with the link we sent you.
verify.sent: We sent a new link to {{email}}
verify.failedHint: Ask for a new link from the notice shown when you log in.
verify.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the full link from the email.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has an account, we sent you a link to choose a new password. It is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Type it twice to be sure.
reset.done: Password changed. You can log in now.

confirmEmail.doneText: Your account now uses this address. Use it the next time you log in.
confirmEmail.failedHint: Ask for the change again from your profile.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.text: Your ads, favorites and photo are removed. Your chats stay for the other person, with your account shown as deleted. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.admin: An administrator account cannot be deleted from here.
deleteAccount.confirmText: This cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.

block.title: Blocked users
block.hint: A blocked user cannot write to you, and you cannot write to them. Their chats stay in your list.
block.youBlocked: You blocked {{name}}. Unblock them to write again.
block.confirmText: Neither of you will be able to send messages in this chat or start a new one. You can unblock them whenever you want.

feature.title: Promote this ad
feature.text: A featured ad is shown first in the searches and stands out with a badge.
feature.removed: The ad is no longer featured
